info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API enables users to efficiently remove items from their shopping cart. This functionality is crucial for maintaining an accurate representation of a user's selected items, ensuring optimal shopping experience. Retail platforms and e-commerce applications can utilize this endpoint to allow customers to manage their carts seamlessly. By integrating this API, developers can enhance the user interface and eliminate unwanted products, ultimately improving customer satisfaction.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This endpoint allows users to remove a specified item from their shopping cart. Upon successful removal, the cart will be updated and the user will receive confirmation of the action.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to specify the item to be removed from the shopping cart. Ensure that the item ID and any relevant parameters are provided in the JSON format.

200.description: The item was successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for removing an item from the shopping cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the removal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the cart removal operation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the removal operation.

state.description: The current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the removal operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the removal operation.

audit.description: Audit details related to the cart removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: Response schema for successful cart item removal operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the removal operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: contains information regarding who created the cart removal entry and when.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
